title: Evidential Ceiling Calculator and reproducibility code for "What AI Red-Team Evaluations Can and Cannot Prove"
description: The evidential ceiling of an AI red-team evaluation (Kaur, 2026, arXiv:2607.21735): the largest factor by which one result can move belief under a fixed testing budget. This release contains the zero-dependency calculator core (JavaScript, with a Python twin), the shared test vectors that reproduce every number in the paper, and the paper's reproducibility code. The calculator runs at https://hackwither.co.in/evidential-ceiling/.
